impactSummary: Authored the complete Hindi localization of ebpf.io, the project's primary front door. It is live at ebpf.io/hi-in/ and is the first Indic-language version of the site. eBPF explainers are dense even in English, so the translation had to settle Hindi renderings for kernel terms that had no established equivalent.
Added the Hindi translation of the Kusion README, giving the project its first Hindi-language entry point for contributors evaluating it.

Documented uninstalling a release with an explicit namespace. The existing page showed the command without the namespace flag, which silently fails or targets the wrong namespace for anyone not working in default.
Contributed a Playwright browser-automation mixin kit, so a sandbox can be provisioned with a working headless browser toolchain rather than each user assembling the dependency set by hand.
A Kubernetes toolchain mixin kit bundling kubectl and Helm, so cluster work in a sandbox does not start with a manual install step.
